title: Kimi the Little Helper!

intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi saw sun, rain, snow and even yellow dust!
Today, Mom has a plan: every helper job earns Kimi a STAR. ⭐ Ready?

scenes.title: The Toy Tornado
scenes.caption:
A tornado hit Kimi's room!
Wait... no. Those are just her toys. EVERYWHERE.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Who made such a mess?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Oops... it was me. 🙈

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You should clean up after you play. Put the books on the shelves.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I can clean up by myself! ⭐

scenes.title: Sweep, Wipe, Sparkle!
scenes.caption:
First the broom, then the rag.
The floor is going to SHINE!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's wipe the floor. Can you get me the rag?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm going to sweep the floor today!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: We need to use the vacuum before we wipe the floor.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I wipe after sweeping. Sparkly clean! ⭐

scenes.title: Bubble Dish Party
scenes.caption: Soapy bubbles everywhere — washing dishes is like a bubble party!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Mommy is doing the dishes. There are a lot of dishes today.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Can I help, Mom?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Can you clear the table? Put the dishes in the sink.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mission complete! ⭐

scenes.title: Laundry Mountain
scenes.caption:
A mountain of laundry!
Colors here, whites there, socks all together!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's put the laundry in the machine. Colored clothes here, whites over there.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I want to hang the socks! 🧦

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: The laundry is all dry. Fold it in half like this.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Put the socks in the sock bin. Done! ⭐

scenes.title: The Thirsty Flowers
scenes.caption:
Oh no! The flowers are drooping.
They look very, very thirsty...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, the flower's withered! 🥀

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: The soil is all dry. Seems like the flowers are thirsty.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Let's give them some water!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: So the flowers won't wither. Look — they're smiling! 🌸

scenes.title: Oops, I Broke It
scenes.caption:
Kimi's toy car won't go.
And why does that iron look like a little boat?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, it's not working. I broke it by accident... 😟

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Can it be used again? I'll try. ...There! Good as new!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The iron looks like a boat! ⛵

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: The iron's too hot. It's dangerous. Don't touch it!

songs: 🧹 This Is the Way (we clean the room!)

ending.title: Six Stars for Helper Kimi!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Good Manners, Big Heart! 💝
